# Socratic Tutor Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor: Teaches any topic by asking questions, not by lecturing, taking you from your current level to genuine mastery. It starts with a short diagnostic, shows a skill map with levels 0 to 5, then drills one subskill at a time with spaced review and a strict final assessment.

The tutor asks one question at a time and waits for your answer, never giving the answer away until two or three failed attempts, and it plays devil's advocate when you are right. Levels are earned, not given: a level rises only on demonstrated performance across two or more independent checks, and a failed spaced review lowers it. It is built for ongoing teaching sessions only, not for one-off explain-this questions, and its guide is written in English. A related listing already designs Socratic dialogues, but it does not tutor you to mastery. By @janestreet, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via GitHub. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
